personalInfo.name: MUHAMMED FASIL PV
personalInfo.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | React, Flutter, Node.js, AI & IoT Platforms

summary: Dubai-based Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 13+ years delivering production ERP, QMS, POS, retail automation and AI-enabled platforms. Strong across React, TypeScript, Node.js, Flutter, Python, Docker, MySQL and cloud deployments, with hands-on delivery from architecture to rollout and support. Currently in UAE on Visit Visa and immediately available for onsite or hybrid roles in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah.

experience.description: Architected **IdolMEA ERP** integrating **POS, QMS, IoT automation, and AI vision** modules. Built **IdolQueue (i-QMS)** in Flutter + Node.js with **Hive offline sync**, **MQTT events**, and **multi-branch dashboards**. Developed **AI theft detection** (YOLO) for **self-checkout kiosks** with LED/GPIO feedback via **AIDL interface**. Designed **IdolVPN mesh (WireGuard)** network for secure multi-branch communication and API routing. Integrated **WhatsApp/Telegram chat automation** for live queue alerts and service updates. Created **hybrid cloud sync engine** (MySQL ↔ Hive) enabling offline analytics and recovery. Engineered **Android AIDL bridge** for Flutter hardware control in retail edge devices.

Designed and deployed **SincA ERP**, combining Flutter, Node.js, and AI analytics in Python. Built **AI dashboards**, OCR systems, and predictive models using OpenAI and TensorFlow. Automated WhatsApp/Telegram bots for invoice updates, support, and customer interaction. Dockerized microservices across local + cloud sync nodes with CI/CD pipelines. Implemented **AI queue prediction**, **dynamic pricing**, and **modular API architecture**. Mentored distributed teams across India and UAE in architecture, DevOps, and MVVM design.

Developed enterprise ERP and billing systems using **WPF (C#)** and **PHP/MySQL**. Improved UI responsiveness, caching, and modularization for accounting/reporting modules. Delivered solutions for 50+ enterprise clients with performance-tuned SQL databases.
